Howmet Aerospace Stock Jumps: HWM Raises 2026 Forecast as Jet Demand Powers Profit Beat

summary_text: Strong Q1 Earnings: Howmet Aerospace beat Q1 estimates with 19% revenue growth and raised 2026 outlook driven by commercial aerospace demand. Stock surged 6.28% after strong Q1 earnings. Howmet climbed 7.7% to $276.16, hitting an intraday peak of $290. Shares jumped 5.7% in afternoon session after impressive 'beat and raise' Q1 2026 results. CEO warned Iran conflict could hit demand momentum. Strategic moves: Howmet wrapped up $1.8B Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing deal April 6; Brunner Manufacturing acquired Feb for ~$120M; offloaded Savannah disk forging plant for ~$230M in March. Free cash flow jumped to $359M (up from $134M YoY). Bought back $300M shares in Q1 plus $150M in April.
